name: Printed Terminal

paperShade.role: secondary ground, dither dark on paper

inkDeep.role: shadows, dense ASCII, all readable text on paper

signal.role: accent: the tracked packet, key numbers

rules: signal appears on at most one subject at a time (the tracked packet)
error used only for failure beats
contrastRules: no readable text in ink below 100% opacity
signal/error text only at >= 66 px regular or >= 52 px bold
tracked packet differs from other packets by shape, size and a paper halo, not colour alone (signal vs ink contrast is only 1.7:1)
captions: inkDeep on a solid paper plate over any texture; emphasis by inversion (paper on inkDeep), never magenta
